proof_0289.moves: A definitional simp lemma: the object part of the unopFunctor from RightResolutions of a localizer morphism to the opposite of LeftResolutions of its op is literally what the definition says, so the proof is rfl. No mathematical step at all beyond unfolding.

proof_0290.moves: Induct on membership in the additive submonoid generated by S: the base case is that setGcd S divides every element of S, the zero case is that everything divides 0, and the closure step is that divisibility is preserved under addition.

proof_0291.moves: Pure definitional unfolding: the underlying multilinear map of ofSubsingleton applied to a continuous linear map is by construction the stated multilinear map, so the proof is rfl. No mathematical content.

proof_0292.moves: A wrapper: unfold the Raw tree map to its internal Impl, extract the internal well-formedness from the Raw WF hypothesis, and apply the already-proved Impl-level statement that isEmpty is equivalent to size being zero.

proof_0293.moves: The coercion of a Finset to a sort is a subtype, so nonemptiness of the coe-sort is exactly the existence of an element satisfying the membership predicate; the whole proof is that one subtype-nonemptiness equivalence.

proof_0294.moves: A thin wrapper: HashMap is a one-field wrapper around DHashMap, so unfold to the inner map and cite the dependent-hash-map version of the same statement.

proof_0295.moves: A wrapper: a Subarray is a slice, and its iterator loop is the generic slice iterator, so the statement follows immediately from the generic slice forIn_toArray lemma. Everything else is iterator/monad instance plumbing.

proof_0296.moves: A wrapper: unwrap the HashMap.Raw to its inner DHashMap.Raw, push the well-formedness hypothesis through WF.out, and apply the corresponding dependent-hash-map lemma about getKeyD after insertIfNew.

proof_0297.moves: A definitional simp lemma: the zeroth component of the natural transformation threeδ₂Toδ₁ between the two composable-arrow functors is by construction the given composite, so the proof is rfl. All the Fin/OfNat/order machinery is index bookkeeping.

proof_0298.moves: A wrapper: repackage the DHashMap as a Raw₀ (the subtype of raw maps with a positive bucket array), feed in its well-formedness field, and apply the Raw₀-level theorem that getKey after inserting a key returns that key.

proof_0299.moves: Build the instance by exhibiting star on the multiplicative opposite as the composite op ∘ star ∘ unop, and chain continuity: unop is continuous, star is continuous on the base, and op is continuous.

proof_0300.moves: Given two valuation subrings with the same associated local subring, apply the underlying-subring map to that equality (congrArg) to get equal subrings, then invoke injectivity of ValuationSubring.toSubring.

proof_0301.moves: Compute the forward component of the left unitor in the Dial category: expand the tensor with the unit as a product with the terminal object, push the composite through prod.lift using comp_lift, kill the terminal factor by uniqueness of maps to the terminal object, and clean up with identity laws so the second projection remains.

proof_0302.moves: Rewrite rotate' at the full length as drop ++ take (valid since length ≤ length), then drop of the whole length is nil and take of the whole length is the list, so the result is [] ++ l = l.

proof_0303.moves: A constant function is continuous, and a continuous function is continuous within any set at any point; the proof is just that composition of the two facts.

proof_0304.moves: Unfold the subset relation to a pointwise membership statement (a congruence under the universal quantifier), then rewrite each membership in powersetCard over univ by its characterization as a cardinality condition.

proof_0305.moves: Definitional: the inverse functor of the dual equivalence of Boolean algebras is by construction the stated functor, so the proof is rfl.

proof_0306.moves: Reduce having finite limits to having limits of shape J for every finite category J, then let typeclass inference supply those from the general construction of limits in a comma category when both functors preserve them.

proof_0307.moves: A wrapper: countBefore with a BEq test is the special case of the predicate version countPBefore, so the zero case follows directly from countPBefore_zero.

proof_0308.moves: Transport both sides of the equivalence from the balanced tree to its sorted list model: minKey? on the tree agrees with minKey? on toListModel (using the ordering part of well-formedness), isEmpty agrees with list isEmpty, and then apply the list-level fact that the minimum key is none exactly when the list is empty.

proof_0309.moves: Every element of an additive group is an additive unit, so the general IsAddUnit version of the uniformity-invariance statement specializes to give the group version.

proof_0310.moves: A wrapper: a HashSet.Raw is a HashMap.Raw with Unit values, so get? on the empty set reduces to getKey? on the empty map.

proof_0311.moves: Use the left characterization of disjointness: suppose x lies in Ico a b and in Ico b c; membership gives x < b from the first and b ≤ x from the second, which contradict each other.

proof_0312.moves: Rewrite the drop of a take using the general drop_take identity, turning it into take (n - n) of a drop; then n - n = 0 and taking zero elements gives the empty list.
